name: Create Reservation
overview: [excited] Let's create an Inventory Reservation! Think of this... as holding specific products for a customer. [friendly] We just link a pool, pick a customer, and set the dates. Easy!

nodes.label: Inventory Pool
nodes.explanation: [casual] First, pick the inventory pool. Let's go with... voice-demo.

nodes.label: Customer Name
nodes.explanation: [casual] Now, search for the customer. Let's use... voice-demo.

nodes.label: Reservation Type
nodes.explanation: [curious] What's the type? FIXED, FLEXIBLE, or ROTATIONAL? Let's pick FIXED.

nodes.label: Start Date
nodes.explanation: [casual] When does the reservation kick in? Pick the start date and time.

nodes.label: End Date
nodes.explanation: [casual] And when does it end? Pick the end date and time.

nodes.name: Reservation Item
nodes.explanation: [excited] Now we allocate quantities! This auto-pulls from the active agreement. Let's look at the items.

children.label: Quantity
children.explanation: [casual] How much of this product are we reserving? Just type the number.

children.label: Qty with Customer
children.explanation: [casual] How much do they ALREADY have? Enter that quantity here.

nodes.label: Notes
nodes.demoValue: Standard inventory reservation for voice demo.
nodes.explanation: [casual] Any special instructions? Jot them down here.

wrapUp: [warm and satisfied] And that's a wrap! [chuckles] Your reservation is set up. Nothing was saved here... but whenever you're ready, go reserve some REAL inventory. You've got this!
description: Walkthrough for creating a new inventory reservation
